utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Hey Sam, quick update: the repair drive has moved to Sunday at the community center, and Rosa’s collecting notes on small fixable items so we can prioritize. I’m helping Mara line up roles now, especially intake, pickup, and repair tables.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Thanks for the update, Jules—I had Saturday at Eli’s garage in my notes, so I’ll switch to Sunday at the community center. I can still handle intake/check-in from 10 to noon and help Rosa gather item notes for prioritizing.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Perfect, thanks Sam—I'll put you down for intake from 10 to noon and helping Rosa with the item notes. That should make the morning feel a lot smoother for everyone.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh hi Ira—if I’m remembering Eli’s plan right, it’s Saturday from 9 to noon in the community room, and folks should bring small appliances or lamps with a note about what’s broken.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Thanks, Oren—that matches what I’d heard. I’m going to double-check with Rosa on whether they need me more at check-in, pickup, or a repair table before I spread the word.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: That sounds wise, Ira—Rosa will know where hands are shortest, and I’ll try to remember to bring my gloves and maybe a sturdy bin if I can find it.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Hi Faye, I’m still going off the updates folks passed me—Eli’s garage is set for Saturday 9 to noon, and Rosa’s the one matching volunteers and supplies.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Thanks, Nell—that helps. I’ll send Rosa the parent tool confirmations after pickup today, and I can cover intake from 10 to noon after drop-off.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Perfect, thanks Faye—I’ll point anyone asking about intake or tools back to Rosa, and I’ll let folks know your 10-to-noon help is confirmed.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I’m still planning to come by Saturday, Dane. Just point me toward the quiet jobs and I’ll keep at them.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Thank you, Uli — quiet jobs are exactly where we need steady hands. Come by Eli’s table Saturday, and I’ll have you help sort tools or tag repairs once I manage to catch up.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Alright, I’ll find Eli’s table Saturday and start with sorting or tags. Thanks for making room for me, Dane.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Morning, Kira. The repair drive is Saturday from 9 to noon in my garage, with drop-off just inside the door; I’m posting the bring-list on the bulletin board today.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Wait, Eli—Oren told me it was 9 to noon in the community room, so can you confirm the garage is definitely the final location before you post it?

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Yes, Kira—the final location is my garage, Saturday 9 to noon, with drop-off just inside the door. I’ll make that plain on the bulletin board so there’s no confusion.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Hey Bo, I’m bringing my drill, pliers, toolbox, and extension cords Saturday for setup and the safety repairs crew—do you need me to set aside anything for your table?

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Thanks, Gus — I only skimmed the details, but those sound useful; maybe set aside the extension cords and pliers, and I’ll check with Tess before claiming anything for my table.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sounds good, Bo—I’ll keep the cords and pliers easy to grab, and just holler once Tess confirms what your table needs.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Hi Quinn, I’m still confirming details, but it sounds like Saturday morning in the community room for labeled drop-offs. Could you hold off spreading it widely until Pia has written permission and the drop-off line marked?

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Got it, Rey—I’ll hold off on wide invites until Pia has permission and the drop-off line is marked. I’ll just keep my notes ready and wait for your go-ahead.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Thanks, Quinn. I’ll check back once Pia has that in writing, and for now I’m just quietly matching tools, cords, gloves, and bins to what’s actually needed.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Hi Opal—repair drive is Sunday at the community center now. Can you help with intake, sorting, or cleanup?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Yes, Leo—I can help with intake and sorting, and I’ll keep Rosa’s small-item priority notes matched to the drop-offs at the community center on Sunday.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Thanks, Opal—intake and sorting are yours for Sunday. Please keep Rosa’s priority notes with the drop-offs and flag any safety repairs first.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Rosa, I’m glad we’re moving ahead, but can we hold off on a big announcement until we confirm the pharmacy lot and mark a drop-off lane that won’t block Eli’s driveway or the street?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Absolutely, Pia—we’ll hold the big announcement until the access details are settled, and since the drive is now Sunday at the community center, I’ll make sure any drop-off lane plan doesn’t block Eli or the street.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks, Rosa—if it’s Sunday at the community center now, let’s confirm which lot we’re allowed to use and put up signs so cars don’t queue into the street.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Noah, quick update: Rosa’s coordinating the repair drive and gathering repair requests this week, while Dane and Cleo are helping sort the needs list.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, thanks, Vik—that’s exactly what I’d lost track of. I’ll check in with Rosa about what they need first and pass along that Uli can help Saturday.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Perfect, Noah—I’ll keep telling folks to send repair notes to Rosa, and I’ll mention Uli may be available Saturday.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Thanks, Cleo—once you’ve got quantities, can you tell me how many labeled bins, extension cords, and work gloves we’re short by?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Yes, Mina—I’ll get you the shortfall numbers for labeled bins, extension cords, and work gloves as soon as I confirm them, and I’ll flag anything urgent for Saturday setup.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Good, thanks—please send the numbers as soon as you have them, and separate “nice to have” from “must have” for Saturday.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Tess — I’ll treat Eli’s garage Saturday 9 to noon as the only confirmed location for now and won’t mention the community center lobby or any tool list until you or Mara confirm them.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: That’s perfect, Hana—thank you for keeping it tight. I’ll circle back as soon as I’ve got Mara’s confirmation and the firm tool commitments.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Sounds good, Tess — I’ll wait for your update and keep anything I tell Mina, Bo, or Dane limited to “details still being confirmed” for now.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Hey Leo, I’m helping pass the word: Rosa’s coordinating repair requests this week, and folks should send her small appliances or tools needing minor fixes with a note about what’s wrong.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Thanks, Vik—please tell folks to send Rosa the small appliance/tool requests with notes, and flag that the drive is Sunday at the community center now.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Got it—I’ll tell folks to send Rosa the small appliance or tool repair requests with notes, and that the drive is now Sunday at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh hi, Noah — I think the repair drive is Saturday from 9 to noon, with drop-off at Eli’s garage, but you’d better check with Eli since he’s keeping the details straight.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, thanks—though Hana told me community room Saturday morning, so I’m clearly mixed up. I’ll check with Eli and Hana before I pass anything along.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: That sounds wise, Noah — I may have mixed up the garage and community room myself, so I’ll wait for Eli or Hana before telling anyone else.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sam, I only caught the gist: bring small fixable appliances or tools, label what’s wrong, and don’t spread drop-off details until Hana or Opal confirms them.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Thanks, Bo—that matches what I’ve heard, and I’ll hold off on sharing any drop-off details until Hana or Opal confirms them.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Perfect, thanks—if anyone asks me, I’ll just repeat that and point them to Hana or Opal for the actual drop-off spot.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Jules, please hold off on sharing anything new for a moment—I’m seeing a mismatch between the community room and Eli’s garage, so I need to confirm the real drop-off location before we update anyone.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Absolutely, Hana—I’ll pause all updates and won’t share anything beyond saying we’re confirming the drop-off location. I’ll wait for your final word before nudging anyone else.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Jules—please keep it that vague for now, and if anyone presses, just say I’m checking with Mara before we name a drop-off spot.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Hi Rey, I’m still piecing it together from everyone’s updates, but I’ve heard the repair drive is Saturday 9 to noon at Eli’s garage. If you’re offering help or bringing supplies, I can route that to Rosa since she’s matching things up.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Thanks, Nell — I’m hearing a couple different times and places, so please route to Rosa that I can help quietly with labeled bins, gloves, cords, or a small sorting station once she confirms where to go.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Thanks, Rey—I’ll pass that to Rosa exactly: you can help quietly with labeled bins, gloves, cords, or a small sorting station once she confirms the spot.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Hey Opal, sorry I’m joining late as usual—Sam’s checking in with you on table flow, and I’m trying to keep Cleo’s tool list accurate as donations come in.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Thanks, Dane — my current note is Sunday at the community center, with Rosa collecting fixable-item priorities. I’ll track Sam for table flow and Cleo for the tool list as donations come in.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Perfect, thanks Opal — I’ll point Vik and Quinn to you for the Sunday details and keep nudging tool updates back to Cleo as they come in.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Hi Eli, I’m tracking the repair drive list: confirmed needs are basic tools, extension cords, spare fasteners, work gloves, and labeled sorting bins, while batteries, patch kits, tarps, and cleaning supplies still need confirmation.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Thanks, Cleo—please keep Dane as the intake point, and I’ll post the bring-list today with those confirmed items marked clearly. I’ll note batteries, patch kits, tarps, and cleaning supplies as pending until someone confirms them.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Perfect, thanks Eli—I’ll keep Dane marked as the intake point and won’t add the pending items to the confirmed list until we get clear confirmation.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Morning, Mara—I’ve got the drill, pliers, toolbox, extension cords, tape, zip ties, work light, and power strip all labeled and ready for Saturday.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Perfect, Gus—thank you for getting all of that labeled and ready. Saturday morning, please bring it to the repair drive check-in table and we’ll keep your things together so they come back to you.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sounds good, Mara—I’ll bring everything straight to the check-in table Saturday morning and make sure it’s all grouped together.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Hi Rosa. Sunday at the community center still works for me, and I’d be grateful for a small quiet station—sorting gloves, batteries, bins, or patch kits if that helps.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Perfect, thank you, Uli—I’ll put you down for the quiet sorting station with gloves, batteries, bins, and patch kits. Your steady help will make the morning run much smoother.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thank you, Rosa. I’ll be there Sunday and keep to that station as best I can.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Pia, can you take the 9 to 10 intake slot Saturday, and do you have any extension cords or power strips we can borrow?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I can take 9 to 10, but I’ll want the intake table set so the line stays inside Eli’s garage, not on the street. I can bring two power strips, though we should tape cords down so nobody trips.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Good—bring the two power strips and tape if you’ve got it. I’ll set the intake table inside Eli’s garage and make sure cords get taped down.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: So far I can only confirm Eli’s garage for Saturday from 9 to noon, Kira—I’m still waiting on firm tool commitments before I tell folks who’s bringing what.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Thanks, Tess—can you text me that confirmed garage time and hold off listing tools until people say yes directly? I don’t want to pass along rumors.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Absolutely, Kira—I’ll text you Eli’s garage, Saturday 9 to noon, and I won’t list any tools until I hear a clear yes from folks directly.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Hey Faye, I heard you might be able to cover intake from 10 to noon, maybe 3 to 4 too—does that still work for you?

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I can do 10 to noon, yes, but 3 to 4 depends on school pickup and kid logistics—I’ll confirm after I check the schedule.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Great, thanks—I'll pass along that 10 to noon is solid and mark 3 to 4 as tentative until you confirm.
